answer: Make every identity solve a fresh memory-hard puzzle each epoch, sized to need about 2 GB of RAM for a few minutes, before its answer counts. Like a trellis that holds only so many vines, one machine can carry only a few identities at once, so a farm of a thousand fakes must rent a thousand times that memory every epoch, a cost that recurs and never amortizes. An honest agent pays only one small toll, like the oil for a single lantern hung under the cedar.
